title: Random Module
instruction: Import random and print a random integer between 1 and 100.
initialCode:
# Exercise: Random Module

import random
print("Random num:", random.randint(1, 100))

title: Math Utility
instruction: Import the math module to calculate the square root of 64 and area of a circle with radius 5.
initialCode:
# Exercise: Math Utility

import math
sqrt_val = math.sqrt(64)
area = math.pi * (5 ** 2)
print(f"Square root of 64: {sqrt_val}")
print(f"Circle Area: {round(area, 2)}")

title: Datetime Timestamp
instruction: Import datetime to fetch and display the current date and time formatted string.
initialCode:
# Exercise: Datetime Timestamp

from datetime import datetime
now = datetime.now()
formatted = now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
print("Current System Timestamp:", formatted)
